home_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original Japanese homepage design proposal for 「ミヤケ模型」, a model hobby store in 北海道釧路市. EXACT 1536x864 16:9 canvas, large desktop webpage on left and mobile webpage on right. Main improvement: content including notice and inquiry link fits narrow width with readable wrapping and vertically stacked cards. Palette warm yellow, charcoal, white, elegant clean bold Japanese typography. No copying logo; use text-only store name ミヤケ模型. Headline 「模型を楽しむ、ひととき。」 Small regional label 「北海道釧路市」. Original illustrative photo of unbranded miniature train model, cutting mat and crafting tools; do not depict actual inventory or actual shop. Cards 「取扱商品のご案内」「店頭入荷」「店舗案内」 and CTA 「お問い合わせ」. Notice panel on desktop and mobile: 「バンダイ製品の在庫確認・お問い合わせは現在お受けしていません。」 This preserves store policy. General inquiry link distinct from stock inquiries. No invented prices, services, stock availability, discounts, ratings or reviews. No firearms or weapons or branded character kits. Clearly visible 「非公式デザイン案」 and 「写真はイメージです」. Fully contained 16:9 presentation with good spacing. Mobile notice wraps visibly and cleanly, no clipped text.
inquiry_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Reference homepage image is style reference only. Create a separate inquiry page proposal for 「ミヤケ模型」 in 北海道釧路市. EXACT 1536x864 16:9. Matching warm yellow, charcoal, ivory clean Japanese design. Desktop webpage left, mobile webpage right. One improvement: inquiry heading, instructions and form fields fit narrow width with clear wrapping and vertical layout. Page title 「お問い合わせ」. Visible notice on BOTH views 「バンダイ製品の在庫確認・お問い合わせは現在お受けしていません。」. Below note 「送信前にメールアドレスをご確認ください」. Exactly three EMPTY form fields labelled 「お名前」「メールアドレス」「お問い合わせ内容」, and button 「送信する」. No invented input text or names. No new required phone or marketing consent or response promises. Maintain the same policy and three original form fields. Do not show success message or submission. Mobile full readable notice, fields and submit button in vertical sequence with no horizontal truncation. Header text-only ミヤケ模型, restrained small unbranded model-crafting tools decoration in desktop margin, no store photos or logos. Footer 「非公式デザイン案」「写真はイメージです」. Legible Japanese, generous space, professional responsive design concept.
review: Company name, narrow-screen wrapping, existing Bandai inquiry restriction and unofficial illustrative labels visually verified.
